method.nodes: Boarding departures at included platforms, grouped by parent_station. Last stop and pickup_type=1 excluded; conditional pickup included and disclosed.
method.links: Traversals between parent-stop pairs; both directions summed. Most frequent clipped shape variant drawn.
method.kilometers: Actual clipped GTFS shape lengths, weighted by dated trip occurrence. Straight fallback disclosed.
method.denominator: All calendar days, including days without service. Service dates use Europe/Stockholm, including after-midnight GTFS times.
method.coverage: Regional feed coverage only. No proof of complete railway or SkiStar ski-bus coverage. Planned supply, not ridership or capacity.
